name: floatops
axis: sqrt / abs / floor / min / max (no transcendentals)
notes: Five float ops per iteration, each a single wasm opcode in VL. The five terms are summed into a local `term` before being added to the accumulator so that every runtime performs the additions in the identical order — an earlier version had `s + a + b + ...` in VL versus `s += a + b + ...` in Rust/JS, which is a different association and produced a genuinely different sum. No NaN and no -0 appears, so wasm f64.min/max, Rust f64::min/max, Math.min/max and Python min/max all agree.
